name: Divider
summary: Horizontal or vertical divider primitive with default and decorative visual styles plus independently configured separator semantics.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default divider thickness; the parent layout owns length and external spacing.

behavior.name: separatorSemantics
behavior.description: Use semantic separator markup for meaningful separation, declare aria-orientation when an exposed separator is vertical, hide purely decorative dividers from assistive technology, and preserve a visible system-color rule in forced-colors mode.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual style of the rule; surrounding layout owns all external spacing.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Axis along which the divider separates adjacent content.

properties.name: semantics
properties.description: Purpose of the divider: decorative is visual only and hidden from assistive technology; structural communicates a separator between regions.

accessibility: Use hr or role="separator" when the divider conveys structure.
Mark decorative dividers as aria-hidden when they add no semantic value.
Set aria-orientation="vertical" when a structural divider uses the vertical axis; horizontal is the implicit separator default.
Keep the rule visible in forced-colors mode without relying on its authored background color.
Do not use the divider line as the only cue for grouped content.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/primitives.css.
